name: Unsafe proc mount
description: A container with securityContext.procMount set to Unmasked bypasses the default masked /proc paths and can expose host process information that should remain restricted.
remediation: Remove securityContext.procMount: Unmasked or set procMount to Default.
test: Check every container in Pods, pod-template workloads, Jobs, and CronJobs for securityContext.procMount set to Unmasked.
